correctness.rationale: The full probability space comprises 3^3 side-label patterns, with single-side degeneracy 1/9, two-side mass 2/3 and three-side mass 2/9. In the two-side case, ordered endpoints x<y on AB and t on AC are acute exactly when x<t/2<y and (t/2-x)(y-t/2)<3t²/4; integrate the product-of-gaps region on t∈(0,1/2) and (1/2,1). This yields f(t)=(3/2)t²[1+log((2-t)/(3t))] and t(1-t/2), giving 4log(4/3)-5/6. A distinct three-side obtuse-angle integration yields (27/2)log(4/3)-7/2. Strict right-angle and vertex cases have measure zero. All mixtures and normalizations were checked independently via numerical quadrature, symbolic identities and 1.2 million direct randomly placed sample triples; no simulation is used as proof.
